detail: Read the public task specification and extracted required alignment, metrics, training assessment, calibration, and output schemas.
Inspected the public CSV header and initial records; confirmed step, train_total_loss, test_total_loss, and component-loss columns.
Inspected the public EXTXYZ frame format; confirmed quoted stress metadata, unquoted identifiers/material, and eight atom fields.
Use structure_id matching across files and atom_id matching within each prediction offset segment; reject duplicates, missing IDs, extras, invalid offsets, and incompatible HDF5 orientations.

Construct lsqlin rows with per-block factors 1/(scale*sqrt(sample_count)) and append three sqrt(lambda)/regularization_scale rows centered at [0,1,1], preserving the exact stated objective and bounds.
Compute calibration-before/after group metrics through one shared implementation and use fitdist(residual,'Normal') for all six residual-distribution fits.
Created the required solution(input_dir, submission_dir) entry point and all local parsing, validation, metric, calibration, statistics, and serialization helpers.
Recorded a concise method summary and the MATLAB-runtime limitation.
Recorded public-file reads, algorithm decisions, and submission writes without accessing non-public references.
